Biomimicry is an approach to innovation that seeks solutions to human challenges by studying and imitating designs found in nature. Engineers, architects, and scientists often examine biological systems that have evolved over millions of years to develop more efficient technologies and sustainable products. For example, the structure of bird wings has inspired aircraft design, while the surface of lotus leaves has influenced the development of self-cleaning materials. As environmental concerns grow, biomimicry is increasingly viewed as a promising strategy for sustainable development.
————————
Biyomimikri, insan sorunlarına çözüm bulmak amacıyla doğadaki tasarımları inceleyen ve taklit eden bir yenilik yaklaşımıdır.
